scope: Read-only Node data audit of the final designed medic hero; no browser use and no asset mutations.
sampling: GLTFLoader and AnimationMixer, inclusive endpoints, approximately 60 Hz. Embedded image/material references are stripped only in an in-memory copy for Node loading; original geometry, skin and animation buffers are unchanged. Weight normalization is inspected in original accessor data before loader adjustments.

direction.note: Toe vectors are anatomical data inference, not visual identification of the face. Asset parent transforms are preserved. Raw mesh width is not sufficient to identify scene forward.

warnings: No explicit weapon/socket/muzzle nodes; hands exist but weapon attachment transforms still need project integration.
